title: Tranche rhythm and acceptance signals — Quarterly playbook for Private Fleet readiness
creator: Lina Chen
description:
Scope: create a prescriptive, repeatable quarterly playbook that defines tranche rhythm (cohort batches), preflight & acceptance signals, and rollback/rollforward criteria for Private/VPC/on-prem customer activations. This ticket pulls together cross-functional checklists (engineering, SRE, sales ops, solutions), telemetry gating thresholds, canary cohort sizing, and a failure-budget policy tied to release windows. Output: a single canonical Confluence playbook + a checklist template that can be copied per customer wave and a short training deck for Customer Success and Sales Engineering.

Key outcomes we need:
- A defined cadence for tranches (size, duration, risk bands) and clear decision gates for moving from one tranche to the next.
- Concrete telemetry acceptance signals (latency P50/P95, error-rate floor, deployment success rate, infra cost deviation) with red/amber/green thresholds.
- A lightweight runbook for on-call and support that includes rollback steps, data migration short-circuits, and emergency contact matrix.
- A documented experiment for staggered canary cohorts and a play to accelerate or pause based on telemetry.
- Cross-team responsibilities matrix and a handoff checklist for final operational ownership.

Why this matters: enterprise private fleets historically stall on the handoff between deployment and steady-state due to ambiguous acceptance signals and inconsistent tranche sizing. This playbook reduces decision friction, shortens time-to-activation, and makes failure budgets explicit for product, infra, and customer success.

Artifacts/links: canonical playbook draft in Confluence (confluence.redwoodinc.com/display/PR/Private+Fleet+Tranche+Playbook), prototype checklist (Drive: /Redwood/PrivateFleet/Checklists/TrancheTemplate.xlsx), example GH PR that motivated the gating thresholds (#repo-infra PR 4821), and telemetry dashboard prototype (Grafana: /d/private-fleet/activation-signals).
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published and linked from Private Fleet onboarding page
Checklist template exportable to customer-specific runbooks
Telemetry dashboard panels created and accessible to SRE and PMs
Rollforward and rollback steps validated in staging with one internal simulated activation
Training deck produced and reviewed by Solutions and CS leads
success_metrics: Median time from deployment completion to customer 'activated' state reduced by 30% for small tranches
Number of post-activation Sev1 incidents attributable to acceptance ambiguity reduced by 60%
Percentage of tranches that progress without manual escalations >= 85%
Support handoff queries per activation <= 3 on average
